finalText:
**The build passes now.** It was failing, not just noisy.

Two real bugs, both from the bump.

| File | Bug | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| [options.js:6](src/core/options.js:6) | `options.retries` renamed to `retryCount` | Read either key |
| [retryPolicy.js:8](src/net/retryPolicy.js:8) | Unset flag is now `undefined`, not `false` | Treat `undefined` as `false` |

The 8 `WARN DEP*` and `W*` lines are real noise. They name old APIs in `src/legacy` and `src/utils`. Those files are not in this repo, so I left them.
